profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, and traded under the ticker PEGA. Its website describes it as an AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, and says organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. The company states that it has worked with large organizations since 1983.

On its own account, the company's current AI offering centers on Infinity 26, which it describes as its latest platform release, built to help enterprises build, orchestrate, and scale AI with predictability, control, and measurable value. It says Pega Platform unifies AI for mission-critical work, and that its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight. Pega Blueprint is described as an AI-powered workspace that combines business and IT around best practices and governance. The company presents its architecture as central to scale and continuous adaptation.

Company records list Pegasystems as a for-profit public company with SEC CIK 0001013857. Its recorded litigation exposure is in Massachusetts, where 187 cases are counted.
